rep.partial_message: Sweep your arms back and out to shoulder height.

checks.label: Shrugging
checks.message: Keep your shoulders down and think of pulling with your rear delts.

checks.label: Body swinging
checks.message: Keep your chest on the pad. Do not rock back to move the weight.

camera.title: Film from 45 degrees
steps: Prop your phone or laptop 2.5 to 3 m away at about chest height, 45 degrees to the front of you.
Both arms and your upper body must stay in view for the whole rep. If the machine hides an arm, move the camera a little.
Light the room from the front or above. A bright window behind you makes the camera lose your outline.
Wear fitted clothing so your joints are visible.
camera.note: Camera at 45 degrees behind and to one side of the machine so both elbows stay visible.

guidance.accuracy: Machines and cables hide parts of your body and move the load on a fixed path, so this rule tracks only the main joint angles and whether your torso stays still. Expect fewer and simpler cues than on free-weight lifts, and some missed reps if the machine covers your arms or legs.
